<br>

GitHub is an online open-source platform for building, storing and collaborating on software projects. It is based on Git, an open-source version control system that keeps track of changes to files and code.

GitHub allows you to store your Git projects, called repositories, in the cloud. It also provides tools for collaboration, version control and sharing your work with others.

## Create a Github Account

1. Go to Github

2. Select Sign up and create an account

3. Choose a suitable username - this will be visible to others

4. Verify your email address when prompted

5. Sign into Github


You will use Github throughout this module to store and submit your R code and projects.





## Additional resources

* Github Instruction [website](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/start-your-journey).
